rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the southwest compass direction.

example.english: The southwest is in the lower-left corner of the map.
example.jyutping: sai1 naam4 fong1 hai2 dei6 tou4 zo2 haa6 gok3

rows.jyutping: hoeng3 sai1 naam4 fong1 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this for an all-purpose attributive expression meaning directed toward the southwest, such as a southwest course.

example.english: This southwest route is best for you.
example.traditional: 呢條向西南方嘅航線最啱你哋。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 hoeng3 sai1 naam4 fong1 ge3 hong4 sin3 zeoi3 ngaam1 nei5 dei6

rows.jyutping: jau4 sai1 naam4 fong1 lei4 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when the noun or force is coming from the southwest, especially with wind.

example.english: The wind coming from the southwest will get stronger tonight.
example.traditional: 由西南方嚟嘅風今晚會大啲。
example.jyutping: jau4 sai1 naam4 fong1 lei4 ge3 fung1 gam1 maan5 wui5 daai6 di1

rows.note: Use this general attributive pattern for something located in or associated with the southwest.

example.english: The villages in the southwest are especially humid in spring.
example.traditional: 西南方嘅村落春天特別潮濕。
example.jyutping: sai1 naam4 fong1 ge3 cyun1 lok6 ceon1 tin1 dak6 bit6 ciu4 sap1
